desc_en: A refined silhouette that redefines urban elegance. This bomber jacket merges contemporary design with impeccable craftsmanship. Its lightweight structure features classic ribbed trims and a full front zip closure. Slanted side pockets and a zipped sleeve pocket provide discreet functionality. Each piece is meticulously crafted on demand to ensure exceptional quality. Available for worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta depurada que redefine la elegancia urbana. Esta chaqueta bomber fusiona un diseño contemporáneo con una confección impecable. Su estructura ligera presenta acabados acanalados clásicos y un cierre frontal con cremallera completa. Los bolsillos laterales inclinados y el bolsillo con cremallera en la manga aportan funcionalidad discreta. Cada pieza se elabora meticulosamente bajo demanda para garantizar una calidad excepcional. Disponible para envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: premium polyester blend with ultra-soft polyester inner lining
· Fit: ribbed collar, cuffs, and waistband
· Closure: full zip front
· Pockets: 1 zipped sleeve pocket and 2 slanted hand pockets
· Made-to-order piece with worldwide shipping available
details_es:
